name: android-kotlin
stack_notes: Prefer coroutines/Flow and explicit state machines for workflows
Avoid flaky UI tests by using idling resources/conditions not sleeps
preferred_patterns: Use Kotlin coroutines (suspend, Flow) rather than blocking waits
Model workflows as explicit sealed-class states + reducer-like transitions
Use structured concurrency and cancellation correctly
Use dependency injection (Hilt/Koin/manual) and interfaces for testability
Prefer unidirectional data flow in UI (especially Compose): state -> UI
testing_rules: Unit tests with JUnit; use coroutine test dispatcher for suspend/Flow
Avoid real delays: use kotlinx-coroutines-test and virtual time
UI tests (Espresso/Compose) must use idling resources / composeTestRule waiting, not sleeps
No real network in unit tests; use fakes/mocks and DI
allowed_exceptions: Delays for backoff/retry must be bounded and driven by state, ideally with virtual time in tests.
Espresso/Compose waiting utilities are allowed; do not use Thread.sleep/SystemClock.sleep.
reviewer_quality_gates: Coroutines must use test dispatchers in unit tests
No placeholder implementations in production paths
